evidence.title: Binary search
evidence.explanation: Binary search repeatedly halves an ordered search interval.

evidence.title: try-except-else-finally
evidence.explanation: else runs when try succeeds; finally runs whether or not an exception occurred.

evidence.title: Unit testing expected exceptions
evidence.explanation: assertRaises succeeds when the wrapped code raises the expected exception.

evidence.title: JSON serialization and numeric values
evidence.explanation: JSON round-tripping preserves these integer values; dividing 19 by 4 yields 4.75.

evidence.title: While loops
evidence.explanation: Integer division halves n until it reaches zero.

evidence.title: Shallow copies
evidence.explanation: list.copy creates a separate outer list, so appending to b does not change a.

evidence.title: Variable positional arguments
evidence.explanation: *nums collects positional arguments into a tuple.

evidence.title: super() calls
evidence.explanation: super().value() calls the parent implementation before adding 2.

evidence.title: Two-sum hash map
evidence.explanation: A hash set tracks previously seen complements to find a pair.

evidence.title: Exception subclasses
evidence.explanation: ValueError is a subclass of Exception.

evidence.title: Table-driven tests
evidence.explanation: Each (input, expected) pair is checked using the same assertion.

evidence.title: CSV-like text processing
evidence.explanation: Skipping the header and parsing column 2 gives numeric scores to sum.

evidence.title: Late evaluation and closures
evidence.explanation: Each lambda closes over the same loop variable; it is evaluated when called.

evidence.title: Nested shallow copies
evidence.explanation: Shallow copying duplicates only the outer list; nested objects remain shared.

evidence.title: Memoization
evidence.explanation: Caching avoids repeated evaluations for the same Fibonacci input.

evidence.title: Method resolution order
evidence.explanation: The C3 MRO visits D, B, C, A, object; B.label is selected first.

evidence.title: Min heaps
evidence.explanation: heapq implements a min-heap; heappop removes the smallest value.

evidence.title: Finally overrides return
evidence.explanation: Returning from finally overrides the pending return from try; avoid this pattern.

evidence.title: Metamorphic testing
evidence.explanation: Metamorphic tests validate relationships between outputs for related inputs.

evidence.title: Security-conscious Python
evidence.explanation: Avoid shell injection, arbitrary code evaluation and disclosure of secrets.
